question: Who among the following has been conferred the prestigious title of ‘Maestro’ by London’s Royal Philharmonic Orchestra, with whom he had been the only Asian to have composed a full symphony as on 6th March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ilaiyaraaja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R. Gnanathesikan**, known as **Ilaiyaraaja, **has been conferred the prestigious title of ‘Maestro’ by London’s Royal Philharmonic Orchestra, with whom he had been the only Asian to have composed a full symphony as on 6th March 2022.
 
• He is an **Indian film composer**, **conductor-arranger**, **singer**, and **lyricist **who **works **in the **Indian film industry**, predominantly in **Tamil cinema **in addition to **Telugu cinema**.
 
• He is a **nominated Member of Parliament **in the **Rajya Sabha **since **July 2022**.
 
• **Music legend **Ilaiyaraaja stands out with his **phenomenal achievements **bringing in structural changes within the **Tamil film world**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allah Rakha Rahman **is an **Indian film composer**, **record producer**, **singer**, and **songwriter **who works predominantly in **Indian cinema **and occasionally **international cinema**. In **2010**, the **Indian government **awarded him **the Padma Bhushan**, the nation's **third-highest civilian award.**
 
• **Devi Sri Prasad **is an **Indian film composer**, **lyricist**, **singer-songwriter**, and **performer**. Popularly known by his **initials DSP**, he is best known for his work in **Telugu films**. He also worked in a few **Tamil films**.
 
• **Gopi Sundar C. S**. is an **Indian music director**, **programmer**, **playback singer**, **songwriter**, **actor**, and performer who works prominently in **Malayalam**, **Telugu, **and **Tamil film industries**.
